use_cases: Hero section text reveals with cinematic blur transitions for landing pages
Animated headlines for SaaS product presentations and marketing materials
Decorative text animations for media and entertainment content
Loading or transition states with elegant word-by-word reveals
Brand statement displays with sophisticated typographic animations
ai_summary: A sophisticated text animation component that creates an elegant blur-to-clear effect on words. Each word animates individually with staggered timing, variable blur intensity, and subtle scale transitions, producing a cinematic reveal effect. Ideal for hero sections, marketing copy, and any context where impactful typography animation enhances the visual experience.
